Bandra (E), Mumbai ‐ 400 051 
Scrip Code: 539725                                  
Symbol: GOKULAGRO 
 
Sub: Intimation of Q2FY27 Earnings Conference Call 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, we wish to update you that the Earnings Conference Call to discuss the Unaudited Standalone 
& Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter / half year ended September 30, 
2026 is scheduled to be held on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 2:30 P.M. (IST) 
 
The Invitation for the Q2FY27 Earnings Conference Call is annexed herewith. 
 
The information is also disclosed on the website of the company at  www.gokulagro.com.    
 
We request you to kindly take the above information on your record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
For, Gokul Agro Resources Limited 
 
 
Jaimish Govindbhai Patel 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
Membership no.: A42244 
 
 
JAIMISH

THE CALL WOULD BE ATTENDED BY THE SENIOR MANAGEMENT OF GOKUL AGRO 
 
About Gokul Agro Resources Limited 
 
► One of India’s leading integrated agri-processing companies with a diversified portfolio across edible oils, castor 
oil & derivatives, specialty fats, feed meals and biodiesel.  
► Operates through 4 strategically located manufacturing facilities, with presence across 28 Indian states and 33 
countries.  
► Strong distribution network of 575+ dealers and distributors, supported by an established position in the B2B 
edible oil segment.  
► Expanding its growth platform through a 300 TPD biodiesel facility and ongoing capacity expansion of 
approximately 8 lakh MTPA.  
► Focused on future growth through branded consumer products, exports, oil palm plantations and renewable 
energy initiatives. 
 
For further inquiries, please get in touch with
